content: <thought>We need to apply the nitro‑to‑amine template (ID 84231) in the retro direction to the given product(s). The product list from the previous step contains two molecules; only the first one has an aromatic primary amine that can be transformed back to a nitro group. Using the apply_template tool will generate all possible nitro‑precursor(s) for that molecule. The second molecule does not match the template, so it will yield no precursors. The final answer should be a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES of the precursor(s) for each applicable product.
